name: Zang Beauty Dubai
address: 119 A Street Exit-1 - near to Union Metro Station - Al Rigga - Dubai - United Arab Emirates
owner_description: Zang Beauty has been known as one of the most loved ladies saloon in the UAE, we are specialized for Hydrafacial, Carbon Laser Facial, BB Glow, Melasma Treatment, Pimple/Acne Treatment, Micro-needling (Tright Treatment) Eyebrows Microblading, Lips Spraying Collagen, Eyelash Extension and Nails Services. With latest Korean Technologies and our experienced experts, we are surely met and exceed your expectations. Our quality of services have been proof by our clients in the last decade. Not only that, we are adding more values for our customers by giving special offers for COMBO's every time.

reviews.author: Chinju Koshy
reviews.text:
I had a very disappointing first visit to this Clinic and would not recommend it based on my experience. Before booking, I specifically called to confirm if a doctor consultation was available, and I was told “yes.” However, when I arrived at the clinic, there was no greeting, no smile, and the receptionist had a very rude attitude.

I was then told that there was no doctor available for consultation and that they “cannot guarantee treatment.” I was also informed that after the first session, I as the patient would need to decide how many sessions I require, which is unprofessional and concerning. The receptionist further stated that she is “the manager, supervisor, and everything” in the clinic, which came across as dismissive.As a manger or supervisor position even she don't know how to spell her name ,which I heard is MAEN.

Overall, the attitude was unprofessional, the clinic was empty with no other patients, and there was an unpleasant smell in the premises. With this level of service and lack of clear medical guidance, I cannot recommend this clinic. It was a waste of time.

reviews.author: Connie Roxanne
reviews.text:
I had the most amazing experience at Zang Beauty getting my lashes done, and I couldn’t be happier with the results! They turned out absolutely beauty—full, natural-looking, and exactly what I was hoping for.

A huge thank you to Huyen for her incredible attention to detail and warm, professional service. She truly has a gift! Highly recommend Zang Beauty to anyone looking for top-quality lash work in a relaxing, welcoming environment.
